known_issues.issue: Battery not detected in slot / BMS communication timeout
known_issues.probable_cause: Worn CAN pins on slot connector

incident_history.symptoms: Batteries inserted in slot 3 show 'Battery not detected'; same batteries work in other slots
incident_history.root_cause: CAN-H and CAN-L pins on slot 3 connector worn and partially recessed
incident_history.resolution: Replaced slot 3 connector assembly (part CONN-SLT-48V-G2), verified CAN handshake with 3 batteries

incident_history.symptoms: RCCB tripped repeatedly, entire station down
incident_history.root_cause: Chafed insulation on slot 6 DC harness touching cabinet frame
incident_history.resolution: Ongoing - slot 6 harness isolated, station restored with slot 6 disabled. Replacement harness ordered (ETA 2026-11-20). PM performed during visit
